description:
MESPOM is the Erasmus Mundus master in environmental sciences, policy and management run by Central European University with Lund, Manchester and the University of the Aegean. For studies in 2027-2029, applications for financial aid and visa-sensitive applicants close on 7 January 2027, with later self-funded rounds on the admissions calendar.

Programme Highlights

  • Four-university consortium spanning Austria, Sweden, the UK and Greece
  • 7 January 2027 deadline for financial-aid and visa-sensitive applicants
  • Strong blend of natural science, policy analysis and management training
  • Alumni across UNEP-type agencies, consultancies and doctoral programmes

Who Should Apply

Graduates in environmental and natural sciences, engineering, economics and policy with a sustainability interest are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus support for eligible applicants in the main round; self-funded routes run later in the spring.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the MESPOM portal and check the deadlines-and-calendar page for the round that matches your funding and visa situation. Key deadline information: 7 January 2027 (financial aid / visa-sensitive applicants); further self-funded rounds per the admissions calendar.
